Website Platform
Field Guide

228 builders, CMSs, frameworks, and hosted platforms — deduplicated, status-checked, and carrying the four things that actually decide a project: what it costs, who can run it after launch, whether the client can leave, and where it stops working.

228 platforms Status & pricing verified Aug 2026 Depth: 0 full · 223 standard · 5 stub Internal scoping tool

Phase 0 — migration complete. Every record is now its own content file behind a schema that fails the build on malformed data. Search, filters, and a page per platform land in Phase 1.

Start here

  • Carrd — Link pages, personal sites, quick validation
  • Duda — Running many client sites under your own brand
  • Framer — Fast, animated launch and marketing sites
  • Hostinger Website Builder — Budget sites where hosting cost decides it
  • HubSpot Content Hub — Clients already running HubSpot
  • Shopify — Any client whose main business is selling products
  • Squarespace — Brand-forward clients who value polish over control
  • Webflow — Custom marketing sites without hand-writing front end
  • Wix Studio — Client sites you build and keep maintaining
  • WordPress.org — Content-heavy sites and anything needing custom functionality
